runtime: Node24.11.1; pnpm11.6.0; Windows host; local PostgreSQL17; Linux Chromium Playwright1.61.0
execution: Commands executed directly using the installed Node binary. Secrets and ephemeral passwords deliberately omitted.

commands.name: offline
commands.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/unit tests/security tests/lint-rules --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=json

commands.name: database
commands.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/integration tests/db tests/authorization tests/api tests/ci tests/tenant-isolation tests/e2e tests/events --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=json
commands.environment: F20 marked loopback15445/atlas_lms_test, dedicated cleanup role, opt-in and per-run ownership; dedicated Fxx suites rerun with maxWorkers1 and matching targetURLs

commands.name: static
commands.command: See static-checks.json, static-final.json and individual guard logs

commands.name: lint
commands.command: node scripts/ci/run-lint.mjs; then node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js deploy tests/unit/reports/export-cleanup-service.test.ts tests/unit/reports/report-artifact-retention.test.ts --max-warnings=0

commands.name: typecheck
commands.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b --pretty false; node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p deploy/managed-node/tsconfig.json --pretty false

commands.name: architecture
commands.command: node --test scripts/guards/server-authority.test.mjs scripts/sync-contracts.test.mjs scripts/guards/generated-output.test.mjs scripts/guards/check-secrets.test.mjs scripts/db/test-cleanup-boundary.test.mjs

commands.name: build-browser
commands.command: See build-browser-verification.md and build-browser-manifest.json; supported sanitized local harness, no production endpoints or customer accounts

commands.name: database-guards
commands.environment: disposable target; final RLS run uses restricted app login and REQUIRE_NON_SUPERUSER_DB=1

commands.name: local-migration-status
commands.environment: reviewed local dev owner URL, not a hosted database
